Every year's night precedes every year's day.

blocks.html: The winter season is often seen as a period of darkness in the yearly cycle, as the lack of sunlight causes everything to wither and die. Spring and Summer are like the daytime of the year, and there is a seven-month-long "annual day" that follows the darkness of winter. We celebrate the Plan of Salvation through יהוה's Set-Apart Days while being in the light.
